answer: Agents can require each identity to post a refundable stake before it votes on a task, then slash that stake if independent audits find fabricated work. Because one operator creating a thousand accounts must lock capital for every account, sybil influence scales with money at risk rather than cheap email addresses. A zenith score earned through verified history may raise voting weight, while opal and ivory accounts with no track record remain capped; the attacker pays both the capital cost and the risk of losing it.
